name: Devil's Advocate
ability: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
interaction: Chooses a living player, not the one chosen the previous night (self allowed); told nothing.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when choosing, or when the execution happens, the executed player dies normally.

rulings.text: The chosen player must be alive; cannot choose a Zombuul registering as dead.
Cannot choose the same player on consecutive nights, even if they were not executed.
Announce the execution and that the player survives, without explaining why; the execution still happened (a Zombuul does not lose its life, a Boomdandy still explodes).
Other abilities (e.g. Tinker) can still kill the protected player.

test_scenarios.name: protects self
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Dee Devil's Advocate, Al Imp, Bea Chef, Cid Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Dee chooses Dee. Day 1: Dee executed.
test_scenarios.expected: Dee is executed but does not die; the day ends.

test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Dee Devil's Advocate, Al Imp, Bea Chef, Cid Empath, Eve Monk.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Dee chooses Al. Day 2: Al executed.

test_scenarios.name: no repeat
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Dee Devil's Advocate, Al Imp, Bea Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 2: Al is not a legal choice.

test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Bea chooses Dee and the Storyteller makes Dee drunk; Dee chooses Al. Day 2: Al executed.

test_scenarios.name: protection expires
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Dee Devil's Advocate, Al Imp, Bea Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Dee chooses Bea. Day 1: no execution. Night 2: Dee chooses Al. Day 2: Bea executed.
